# AgentPress Material Kit: Redis: sql server

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://redis.io/docs/latest/integrate/redis-data-integration/data-pipelines/prepare-dbs/sql-server

Run locally:

```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:

Rules:
